description: Source code implementing cryptographic functions using mbedtls, including cipher context creation, encryption/decryption, and utility functions for cipher info.

methods.name: hexstr2buf
methods.description: Converts a hex string to a buffer, returning the buffer and its length.

methods.name: get_default_cipher
methods.description: Returns the default cipher info (AES 128 CBC).

methods.name: get_cipher_or_print_error
methods.description: Retrieves cipher info by name, printing supported ciphers if invalid.

methods.name: get_cipher_ivsize
methods.description: Returns the IV size for a given cipher.

methods.name: get_cipher_keysize
methods.description: Returns the key size in bytes for a given cipher.

methods.name: create_ctx
methods.description: Creates and initializes a cipher context for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: do_crypt
methods.description: Performs encryption or decryption on input file data using the provided context.

methods.name: free_ctx
methods.description: Frees and cleans up a cipher context.
